widget.name: PDF Template Designer
widget.description: Design PDF templates by placing overlay fields on top of a base PDF.

property.caption: Template definition
property.description: Context object for FormConfiguration (or equivalent). Required in Designer mode; optional in Viewer mode.

property.caption: Template JSON
property.description: LongString attribute that stores the template JSON.

property.caption: Data JSON
property.description: LongString attribute that stores Viewer mode field values as a JSON object. Recommended for Viewer mode so edits/signatures persist.

property.caption: Field key schema JSON
property.description: Optional String/LongString attribute containing a JSON Schema object for key options when Field key source = Dropdown from JSON.

property.caption: Base PDF datasource
property.description: Datasource that returns the base PDF FileDocument object. The widget uses the first item.

property.caption: On change
property.description: Action executed whenever the template JSON changes from editor interactions.

property.caption: On save
property.description: Action executed after saving TemplateJson/DataJson (usually a commit microflow).

property.caption: Field key source
property.description: Choose how field keys are sourced. In dropdown modes, the Palette lists keys for one-step placement and Field properties uses a key dropdown. Built-in key options are also included: __currentDate, __currentTime, __currentDateTime, __signature.

property.caption: Field key options datasource
property.description: Datasource that returns records containing allowed field key values for the key palette and property dropdown. Built-in key options are automatically added (__currentDate, __currentTime, __currentDateTime, __signature).

property.caption: Field key option attribute
property.description: Attribute that contains the key value to use in the dropdown.

property.caption: PDF.js worker URL
property.description: Text template for the PDF.js worker script URL. Leave empty to use the default worker URL.

property.caption: PDF.js script URL
property.description: Text template for the PDF.js core script URL (pdf.min.js). Leave empty to auto-derive from the worker URL or use default.

property.caption: SigWeb script URL
property.description: Optional URL to SigWebTablet.js for external signature pad integration in Viewer mode.

property.caption: Show shortcut hints
property.description: Show or hide the shortcuts help text in the editor toolbar.

property.caption: Enable keyboard shortcuts
property.description: Enable keyboard shortcuts such as undo/redo, duplicate, delete, and arrow-key nudging.

property.caption: Show field properties
property.description: Show or hide the right-side Field properties card.

property.caption: Show palette section
property.description: Show or hide the Palette section in the left sidebar.
